site_note: V2 item 5.3 (two primaries): only on a Case File linked to the same patient's other Case File, and only for histopathology, cytology, IHC and molecular records: among several candidates for one record, or several documents carrying a required value, one that names another protocol's site and not this one steps aside and is named on the row for review; a document naming no site never does, and when every candidate names another site every candidate stays. Organ words only. A preference, never a filter; a patient with one cancer is checked as before.
note: DRAFT, not approved for real use: needs a clinician's check. Configurable by the clinical team. Required records transcribed from the NCG Guidelines for Urological Malignancies (2019) (National Cancer Grid, India), the testicular tumour pages (management p 20 to 25, the radiology and pathology formats p 46 and 49 to 50), each with its verbatim quote and page. Tiers printed by NCG are kept; the tiers whose tier_basis says 'proposed' or 'proposal' (clinical_history) are proposals, to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use). A record NCG gives only under a condition the system never judges (an age, a finding, a plan) is shown with NCG's own tier and the condition, never counted. Seminoma and non-seminoma differ in the book's pathways; this is one checklist with three settings, as the system never decides the histology. Ovarian or extragonadal and childhood germ cell tumours are in other books. The stage and the risk group are as recorded by the clinician, never computed. Nothing here suggests treatment.
settings_note: Setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage). The three settings follow the book's pathways: Stage I seminoma and Stage I NSGCT (p 21, 23), Stage II and III seminoma and NSGCT (p 22, 24) and relapsed disease (p 25).
